name: hr_people
summary: Employment history, job grades, dependents and expiry alerts
description: Adds effective-dated, append-only employment history (department/position/manager/cost-center/location over time), a job-grade ladder with salary bands, structured employee relationships (dependents and emergency contacts), and scheduled alerts for expiring contracts, probation periods and documents. Extends the hr anchor without migrating its tables; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
